recipe.visualDefinition: A group of humanoid figures emerging from or forming the head of a comet, streaking diagonally across a deep blue starfield. The figures are rendered in a monochromatic, glowing blue-white style with long, trailing light-tails that merge into a singular cosmic plume.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures are locked in a diagonal ascending line from bottom-left to top-right.
The comet tail creates a massive gradient of light against the dark void.
Typography follows the arc of the comet's trajectory in the upper right quadrant.
A stark white rectangular block at the bottom provides a high-contrast metadata area.
coreInvariants: Glow effect on all central subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The humanoid comet occupies the central diagonal axis, scaled to dominate the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The leading humanoid figure at the top-right of the comet chain.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the comet tail from the bottom-left up to the figures, then to the arched text in the top-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blue starfield occupies the corners, providing breathing room for the bright central elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the luminous, desaturated blue subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to shades of blue and white

letterConstructionRules: Arched baseline following a circular path
Thick, blocky strokes with rounded corners
Inner glow or inline detail to mimic the comet's luminosity
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are warped to fit a perspective arc
Terminals are softened to match the airbrushed aesthetic
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, arched display face paired with a clean, multi-column sans-serif for technical metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded retro feel of the era.
Captures the tubular, glowing sci-fi aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a deep blue space background with a stippled starfield. Include a diagonal comet-like streak of light from bottom-left to top-right, ending in a cluster of glowing humanoid figures. Leave a white rectangular space at the bottom center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom arched lettering in the top-right corner following the curve of the comet head. Use a heavy, rounded sans-serif with a subtle outer glow. Populate the bottom white box with two columns of technical text in a clean sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the comet trajectory strictly diagonal?
Does the text follow the arc of the comet head?
Is the color palette strictly monochromatic blue and white?
Is the bottom metadata block a clean, high-contrast white rectangle?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles
Specific facial features of the figures

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between art and metadata

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the figures blend seamlessly into the comet tail.
Check that the glow effect doesn't obscure text legibility.
Verify the white metadata block is perfectly rectangular.
Confirm the starfield has varied grain sizes for depth.
recipe.reuseFormula: Diagonal Luminous Subject + Arched Display Type + High-Contrast Metadata Footer
